owner_decisions: AM-0020 is additive after AM-0019 and preserves every non-conflicting prior requirement.
Review is a control signal for remediation and completion; false ACCEPT and false REJECT are both systemic failures.
Workers, verifiers, scope reviewers, integration reviewers, final challengers, adjudicators, the engine and the main reporting agent have separate authority.
A reviewer may ACCEPT only an exact claim scope and can never declare the project complete.
Only an engine-compiled terminal report may determine local-ready, staging-ready, production-ready or HV3_M11_LOCAL_COMPLETE.
DeepSeek remains the main economical implementation model; stronger or different-provider reviewers are reserved for material risk boundaries.
No-vision review cannot issue visual/taste PASS and Playwright-only evidence cannot issue raw-CDP PASS.
All terminal evidence binds an immutable candidate epoch and becomes stale when a dependency changes.
Blind adversarial review precedes reading the worker verdict; review conflict is adjudicated rather than majority-voted.
Mini TOEIC and POS Ops failure patterns become controlled fixtures; neither external repository is mutated.
Review remains sharded and concurrent so stronger assurance does not recreate a sequential pipeline.
M11-R27 through M11-R36 are additive and execution continues through their closure before the M11 terminal decision.
in_flight_context: At capture time the AM-0019 execution was running the full engine/CLI gates before dispatching five independent final reviews. Those commands may finish and remain candidate evidence, but no prior-contract review or terminal verdict is terminal-eligible for AM-0020 without revalidation.
activation_rule: After any in-flight non-mutating command finishes, checkpoint without discarding work, verify original/AM-0019/AM-0020 bytes, activate AM-0020 after AM-0019 atomically, recompute effective identity, stale prior review and terminal eligibility, regenerate shadows, retain NEEDS_REMEDIATION, then implement and dogfood R27-R36 before any HV3_M11_LOCAL_COMPLETE decision.
